name: Power Shrug
instructions: Stand holding a barbell at mid-thigh with an overhand grip.
Dip slightly and extend your hips explosively.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears as the bar rises.
Allow your elbows to bend slightly at the top.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: An explosive shrug from the hang position that trains the traps and the power pull.
